context:
Goal: every recorded gap gets fixed, not piled up.
Problem (rule): each `Fix: none` note gets an `Until:` review date, and that date needs a cap. The agent found no standard number, so the cap is your call.
Based on (measured): on origin/main, notes grow about 104 lines a day and 33 of them carry `Fix:`. Debt files open about 13 a day and close about 4. 410 live note lines are older than 10-26, and the oldest is from 10-17. About 1,250 kept notes will get an `Until:` date, spread across the cap, so the cap sets the monthly re-review load (coordinator, 14:08 CST).
Departs from: main, where a note has no review date. The change adds an `Until:` date with a cap to each `Fix: none` note.

options.gain: Each kept note is looked at again every month.
options.label: 30 days (recommended)
options.lose: About one sweep lane a month.

options.label: 60 days
options.lose: A gap can wait two months.
